pnpm install failed since left-pad-lite is missing from the lockfile and must be added.
correct_alts:
The web-build job failed in pnpm install --offline because the cache restore for pnpm-store-linux-a41c broke with a truncated archive, so the store was empty and left-pad-lite 2.0.3 could not be fetched offline.
The cache warning was the root cause, not the install step.

Restoring the pnpm cache failed (unexpected end of archive for key pnpm-store-linux-a41c), and because the next step installs offline it died on the missing left-pad-lite tarball, so the install step is only the symptom of the broken restore.
